int_name: RISING SUN AVE & E TABOR RD

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility continental crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of degraded pavement in the roadway present safety concerns.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and patching in the asphalt within the intersection and crosswalk area can create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and within the crosswalk area.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals which may lead to confusion.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and ensure clear visibility of pavement markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks and signalized traffic control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the roadway surface is significantly degraded with cracks and patches, and the wide crossing distance lacks a median refuge, increasing pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven asphalt in the intersection and near the crosswalk create trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate trip hazards and improve the visibility of pavement markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning pads, and pedestrian signals. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic in a commercial environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area may present minor trip hazards.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and basic sidewalk infrastructure but is dominated by a car-centric design. Pedestrians face significant conflict points due to the adjacent gas station driveways and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Gas Station Conflict Points
hazards.description: The Liberty gas station has wide, undefined driveways immediately adjacent to the intersection, creating frequent unpredictable vehicle movements across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the Liberty station

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is situated on the corner, potentially narrowing the accessible path for wheelchairs or strollers near the curb ramp.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down vehicles making right turns into or out of the side streets.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and Leading Pedestrian Intervals (LPI) to improve safety and visibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the gas station entrances to reduce the conflict zone and slow down entering/exiting vehicles.
